stories.title: $10 programmer saves BIOS-locked Lenovo ThinkPads from the dump
stories.summary: Many cheap company ThinkPads come with supervisor passwords and often end up as e-waste. Ukrainian YouTuber Hileeq shows how easy it is to bypass the password with a $10 programmer.

stories.title: Software engineer Rickrolls his Prusa 3D printer via remote code execution exploit
stories.summary: A software engineer demonstrated the ability to Rickroll a 3D printer via remote code execution (RCE). This security flaw has been fixed in the latest Prusa software.

stories.title: Upgrade your PS5's storage for GTA 6's digital pre-load with these SSD storage options from $174
stories.summary: With GTA 6's digital pre-loads beginning on November 10, you'll need enough storage on your PS5 to match. Here are some of the top PS5 SSD options to help you.

stories.title: Steam Store adds average FPS data so you can see game performance before making a purchase
stories.summary: Valve is adding a new feature to the Steam store that tracks performance data and then displays it anonymously to users who match the hardware.

stories.title: Grab this GameSir Super Nova wireless controller at a record-low Amazon price, now under $40
stories.summary: Grab this fully loaded wireless gaming controller from GameSir for a record-low Amazon price of $39.99.

stories.title: Grab 32GB DDR5 for $371 in this Newegg RAM bundle with the 9800X3D, $70 less than buying it separately
stories.summary: This Newegg bundle brings together the AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, 32GB of DDR5-6000 RAM, a Gigabyte X870 Aorus Elite Wi-Fi 7 motherboard, and a free ATX case for $1,090.98.

stories.title: Seagate resurrects hybrid storage: Hands-on with the FireCuda Forge – 8 or 20TB external hard drive requires you to bring your own NVMe SSD
stories.summary: Seagate takes on high SSD storage prices with the Firecuda Forge, a 8TB or 20TB hard drive that requires you to bring your own M.2 2280 SSD (ideally 1TB, with DRAM). It's a throwback to the days of hybrid drives, and the experience is pretty seamless once you install your SSD. But if you don't already own an SSD that you can drop in, it's still quite expensive.

stories.title: All net-connected vehicles from two major automakers allowed hackers to remotely unlock doors and start the engine
stories.summary: Any net-connected vehicle from two automakers could be remotely opened and started — now-patched failures with API backend security showcase a lack of 101-level best practices

stories.title: Orbiting ESA satellite plays Doom after receiving voice commands from amateur radio operators on Earth
stories.summary: Radio amateurs in Oslo spoke a command to ESA’s OPS-SAT PRETTY satellite, which recognized it on board and launched Doom.

stories.title: Law firm files class-action lawsuit against Nvidia after CEO Jensen Huang confirms affair with alleged Chinese spy
stories.summary: Class-action lawsuit and legal investigations against Nvidia over securities fraud start flying

stories.title: Ethereum Foundation sued after firing employee over mandatory 'Source Seppuku' suicide pact
stories.summary: A former employee of The Ethereum Foundation is suing the nonprofit after being fired for refusing to sign its 'Source Seppuku License.'

stories.title: Nvidia cracks down on overseas cloud AI GPU rentals for China
stories.summary: Nvidia may cap cloud partners’ Chinese business at 49% as Chinese firms buy up more than 1 million gaming and workstation GPUs.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to Congress over affair with alleged Chinese spy
stories.summary: Jensen Huang has been summoned to appear before Congress's Select Committee on the CCP.

stories.title: Bizarre AI chip demo uses butter to highlight how new chip runs 40 degrees cooler than the competition
stories.summary: DEEPX demonstrated its DX-M1 processor’s cool running capabilities in a bizarre dairy-based thermal benchmark.

stories.title: Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI Review: Slim OLED gaming that doesn't last long
stories.summary: The Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI pairs strong gaming performance, a 240 Hz OLED display, and good upgradeability but compromises the package with relatively short battery life.

stories.title: Nvidia RTX PRO 6000 user’s cables almost melted, even when limited to 500W
stories.summary: The 12V-2x6 connector nearly took out two RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation GPUs; luckily, the owner spotted the damaged cables before they melted the GPU connectors.

stories.title: Anthropic skips six-year waitlist with massive $3.4 billion gas turbine generator deal
stories.summary: Anthropic has committed $3.4 billion to secure 1.7GW of gas-fired generators from OnePWR Solutions, taking over existing Caterpillar orders as lengthy equipment lead times push AI companies to build their own power infrastructure

stories.title: Memory shortage spurs smartphone makers to melt used memory off old devices, then re-solder it onto new products
stories.summary: Reballed memory currently accounts for a small share of smartphone components, but adoption could nearly double by 2027 as manufacturers look for alternatives to increasingly expensive DRAM.

stories.title: Lawyer builds private AI server with eight used Nvidia V100 GPUs
stories.summary: A lawyer runs DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on eight used 2018-era Nvidia V100 GPUs at up to 215 tokens/s, keeping case files in the office.

stories.title: China builds massive 800-megawatt AI data center campus to rival US Stargate project
stories.summary: Envision has delivered the first 120MW of its Galaxy AI datacenter in less than a year, combining wind farms, battery storage and an unconventional cooling system to cut costs and keep power-hungry servers running
